about: Reviewed starting inputs for the font-layout-var target. The first byte picks the font's shape: 1 to 3 axes (its value modulo 3), value records without a stored x advance (bit 2), GSUB lookup variation records (bit 3), GPOS feature variations (bit 4), and, or and not conditions (bit 5), and the first class count of the class kerning lookup (bit 6). The next 48 bytes choose the store's regions and deltas, three kerning lookups with devices, the features' lookups, the variation records and the text; every following 4 bytes (up to four times) choose one location (bytes 1 to 3: an axis at its minimum, default, maximum or a fraction between, by the value modulo 4). The font is built with 24 and 192 glyphs and 8 times the regions, pairs and substitution lookups.

seeds.why: one axis, device deltas only at the corners
two axes with four locations: corners, the default and fractions
value records holding only a device (no stored advance)
only a choice byte: everything from zeros
